EN:
Shoo!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Get outta here, ogre!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
And gimme some good luck today!
FR:
Ogre, vil ogre, rentre chez toi !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Et qu'à la peur succède la joie !
IT:
Via!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Pussa via, spiritaccio malvagio!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
E lasciami un po' di fortuna!
TRANSLATION:
Kışt!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Git buradan, oni! Bugün{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
bana da biraz iyi şans bırak!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}It wouldn't be {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bean Day{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} without
some good old-fashioned bean
throwing!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}I didn't hurt you, did I?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Sorry about
that,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡No sería el Día de la Habichuela
si no lanzásemos unas cuantas
habichuelas como es tradición!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}No te he hecho daño, ¿verdad?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¡Perdona,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ça ne serait plus le jour du
haricot si on n'en lançait pas au
moins quelques-uns !
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Je t'ai pas fait trop mal, j'espère ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Pardon si c'est le cas,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Es wäre kein guter {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bohnentag{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},
wenn ich dich nicht mit Bohnen
bewerfen würde!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Hat das etwa wehgetan?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
'tschuldigung,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Seguro que todo esto de lanzar
habichuelas nos protegerá de los
ogros. ¡Pero se me cansa el brazo!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}J'espère que j'ai lancé assez de
haricots pour tenir les ogres
éloignés pour le reste de la journée.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}C'est que je commence à avoir des
crampes au bras, moi !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Ich hoffe, das Bohnenwerfen hält
uns wirklich die Oger vom Leib.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Mein Arm tut schon weh!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Umarım bu kadar fasulye atmak
bizi onilerden korur. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Kolum
yoruldu bile!

{{TAG:0003:0017:}}İşe yaramadı mı? {{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Beni
kandırmaya çalışıyorsun{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0002:}}!
Yemezler, oni{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}! Bütün gün sana
fasulye atacağım!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}AUGH!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Where'd you get those
beans, ogre?!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}It's not fair!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} You can throw them or
get them thrown at you,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} but not
both!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}¡AAH!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡¿De dónde has sacado
esas habichuelas, ogro?!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}¡No es justo!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Vale lanzarlas
o que te las lancen,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡pero
no las dos cosas!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}ARGH !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Mais d'où tu sors ces
haricots, l'ogre ?!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}C'est pas du jeu !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Soit tu en lances,
soit tu en prends plein la poire !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Mais pas les deux !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Ehi!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Dove hai preso quei fagioli,
spirito malvagio?!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Non vale!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} O li tiri, o te li tirano.
Questa è la regola, non puoi
fare tutte e due le cose!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}Argh!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wo hast du denn die Bohnen
her, Oger?!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Das ist fies!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Du kannst sie werfen
oder damit beworfen werden,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} aber
doch nicht beides!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}{{TAG:0007:000B:}}AAA! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}O fasulyeleri nereden
buldun, oni?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}! Bu haksızlık{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}! Ya
fasulye atarsın ya sana atılır;
ikisi {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}birden olmaz!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Man, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}I could eat a whole mountain
of beans.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Huy, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}podría comerme diez ollas
de habichuelas.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}S'il fallait pas garder ses haricots
pour les ogres,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} j'aurais déjà mangé
tous les miens...
IT:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Avrei proprio voglia di una bella
zuppa di fagioli adesso...
TRANSLATION: {{TAG:0003:002B:}}Off.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}.. Dağ kadar fasulye yiyebilirim.

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Es el Día de la Habichuela,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡y me
hace ilusión usar un puñado de ellas
para espantar ogros,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Aunque me siguen dando bastante
miedo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}C'est le jour du haricot !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} J'ai
hâte de bombarder tous les ogres
de la ville,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Enfin, du plus loin possible quand
même{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Oggi è Setsubun e ho proprio voglia
di prendere a fagiolate qualche
spirito malvagio,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Non importa se sono spaventosi
e ho una fifa tremenda{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Es ist {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Bohnentag{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Heute vertreibe
ich die bösen Oger mit meinen
Bohnen,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Obwohl sie eigentlich schon ganz
schön gruselig sind{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.

ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Entonces...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¿será cierto que
lo único que funciona contra
los ogros son{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. las habichuelas?
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}È vero che i fagioli sono l'unica
arma efficace contro gli spiriti
malvagi?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Look at all those beans you've
got there, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I hope you're using them to fight
bad luck{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} and not just to, like, make
chili or something.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¡Cuántas habichuelas tienes
ahí, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Espero que las estés usando para
combatir la mala suerte{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} y no para,
qué sé yo, hacer una fabada.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}T'as un sacré stock de haricots,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}} !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}J'espère que tu t'en serviras pour
combattre les ogres,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} pas pour
te faire un cassoulet !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Guarda un po' quanti fagioli hai
racimolato, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Se non devi tirarli tutti agli spiriti
malvagi, me ne dai qualcuno?
Voglio farmi una zuppa!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Du hast aber viele Bohnen,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich hoffe, du vertreibst damit das
Böse und willst dir damit nicht
etwa ein Chili kochen oder so!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Şu fasulyelere bak, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Umarım
kötü şansı kovalamak için {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
kullanıyorsundur; chili falan
yapmak için değil.

EN:
I know I'm not an ogre,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} but I don't
mind if you throw some beans at
me, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}I could use a quick snack right
about now,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
Sé que no soy un ogro,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} pero no me
importaría que me lanzases unas
cuantas habichuelas, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Así podría atrapar algunas en el
aire para la cena,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
Je sais que je ne suis pas un ogre,
mais je ne le prendrais pas mal si
tu me lançais des haricots.
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}J'ai comme qui dirait une petite
fringale, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
So di non essere uno spirito
malvagio, ma se vuoi puoi benissimo
tirarmi qualche fagiolo, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Ho un po' di fame e uno spuntino
non sarebbe una cattiva idea,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
Ich bin zwar kein Oger, {{TAG:0005:0008:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
aber du darfst mich gerne
trotzdem mit Bohnen bewerfen!
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Ein kleiner Snack käme mir jetzt
nämlich gerade recht,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
Oni olmadığımı {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}biliyorum ama
bana biraz fasulye atabilirsin, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}
. {{TAG:0003:0004:}}Şu an kısa bir atıştırmalık
fena olmazdı,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}You lucky duck! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}You've got some
beans!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Their taste is mild, but
they're still good!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}To be honest,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I think throwing them
is kind of a waste,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} even if it does
get rid of ogres,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}¡Qué bien te lo montas! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡Tienes
habichuelas!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Pero debo confesarte
que me preocupa una cosa...
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La verdad,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} creo que lanzarlas es un
desperdicio.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡Aunque nos libremos
de los ogros,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}I fagioli non ti mancano, vedo!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Se ne avessi, li farei lessi...
o magari a zuppa...
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Insomma,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} tirarli agli spiriti malvagi
è un po' uno spreco secondo me,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Oooh,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} du hast ja Bohnen dabei!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Leckere Bohnen...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Eigentlich hab ich mir schon oft
gedacht, dass es Verschwendung
ist, Oger damit zu bewerfen.
Klar,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} es ist schön, die bösen Oger
loszuwerden,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} aber Bohneneintopf
ist auch schön!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Äh, he he he!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Şanslısın! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Fasulyelerin var{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}!
Tadı hafif ama güzel. Doğrusu{{TAG:0003:0001:}},
oni {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}kovsa bile onları fırlatmak {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
biraz israf gibi geliyor,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I'm happy to see you and I are
both totally stocked with beans.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
We are ready to fight bad luck!
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Now we just gotta wait for some
ogres to stumble by,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Me alegro de ver que tú y yo ya
tenemos listas las habichuelas!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
¡Lucharemos contra la mala suerte!
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Ahora solo tenemos que esperar
a que se deje caer por aquí
algún ogro,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je suis content de voir que toi et
moi, on est parés contre une
attaque d'ogres !
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}J'aimerais pas être à la place du
prochain qui passera par là,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Insieme abbiamo un bel po' di fagioli
da tirare agli spiriti malvagi!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}La lotta contro il male può avere
inizio, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wir haben ja beide jede Menge
Bohnen dabei!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Da können wir
alles Böse vertreiben!
{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Jetzt müssen wir eigentlich
nur noch einen Oger finden,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}İkimizin de cepleri fasulye
dolu, ne güzel. Kötü{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} şansla
savaşmaya hazırız{{TAG:0003:0021:}}! Şimdi
önümüzden bir oni geçse yeter,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}
.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Looks like we're both all set in the
bean department, huh?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:000B:}}Now all we
need is an ogre,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ah, los dos estamos provistos en lo
que a habichuelas se refiere.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:000B:}}Ahora
solo nos falta el ogro,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I fagioli ci sono...{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:000B:}}Ora dobbiamo
solo aspettare che si faccia vivo
uno spirito malvagio,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Guck mal,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} wir haben ja beide jede
Menge Bohnen!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:000B:}} Aber wo bekommen
wir jetzt einen Oger her?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Fasulye konusunda ikimiz de
hazırız galiba. Şimdi{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:000B:}}tek
eksiğimiz bir oni,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Are your beans for warding off bad
luck?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Or are they for eating?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}I love
how versatile beans are!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Tes haricots{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} tu comptes les
lancer, ou les manger ? {{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Moi je les
garde pour faire un chili con carne !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Come userai i tuoi fagioli?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Li tirerai
agli spiriti o te li mangerai?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Sono
davvero versatili, non credi?
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Willst du mit den Bohnen alles Böse
vertreiben?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Oder willst du die etwa
aufessen?
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Äh, he he he!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich find's toll, dass
Bohnen so vielseitig sind!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0017:}}Bu fasulyeler kötü şansı kovmak
için mi, yemek{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} için mi?
Fasulyenin bu {{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}}kadar çok işe
yaramasını seviyorum!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}¡Atrás, ogro!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡O probarás la ira
de mis habichuelas feroces!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0013:}}¡Oh, no!{{TAG:0007:0000:3C000000}} ¿Mis habichuelas han
salido corriendo,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?

FR:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ma maison est interdite aux ogres !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Ouste ! Du balai,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Hier sind keine Oger erlaubt!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Husch, husch,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} raus hier!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}It's weird to say,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} but I feel kind of
bad for you,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} what with everyone
throwing beans at you.
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}I guess you can hang out in my
house for a while if you want,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Te parecerá raro,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} pero me das
algo de pena,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} con todo el mundo
tirándote habichuelas.
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Si quieres, puedes refugiarte
en mi casa y jugamos un ratito
a la consola,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Je sais que ça peut sembler bizarre,
mais ça me rend triste que tout le
monde soit méchant avec toi...
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Si tu veux te cacher un petit
moment chez moi, tu peux,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}A dire il vero, un po' mi spiace
per te... Insomma, tutti ti tirano
fagioli, nessuno parla con te...
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Puoi rimanere un po' qui da me,
se ti va,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Eigentlich ist es schon fies,
dass du den ganzen Tag mit
Bohnen beworfen wirst.
Armer Oger...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0027:}}Du darfst dich gerne
eine Weile hier in meinem Haus
verstecken,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
